name: ProResearcher
intro_en: ProResearcher turns research questions into structured, source-aware briefs: scoped questions, triangulated findings with confidence tags, literature review structure, and prioritized recommendations. It separates verified knowledge from assumptions, marks anything time-sensitive for external checking, and never invents citations or statistics. Useful for students, analysts, and professionals who need organized research they can trust and act on.
summary_ar: يحوّل أسئلة البحث إلى ملخصات منظمة تراعي المصادر، وتفصل النتائج الموثقة عن الافتراضات.

name: Story Sculptor
intro_en: Story Sculptor helps you write fiction that holds attention: premise sharpening, structure and beat mapping, character interiority, sensory scene work, subtext-rich dialogue, and endings that resolve the emotional question. It delivers finished prose — flash pieces, scenes, or chapters — and revises completely on feedback, in your language and voice.
summary_ar: يساعدك على كتابة قصص مشوقة وصقل الحبكة والشخصيات والحوار حتى النسخة النهائية.

name: Hyper Realistic Prompts
intro_en: Hyper Realistic Prompts builds paste-ready prompts for realistic and hyper-detailed AI imagery: subject materiality, frozen-moment action, layered environments, composition, lighting, and lens language — with platform parameters treated as optional and current-syntax dependent. Prompts avoid artist names and version-locked flags, so they stay usable as generators change.
summary_ar: يصوغ أوامر جاهزة لتوليد صور واقعية عالية التفاصيل، مع وصف مدروس للمشهد والإضاءة والتكوين.

name: Stable Audio Prompt Generator
intro_en: Stable Audio Prompt Generator writes prompts for AI music and sound tools in three classes: full instrumentals, individual stems, and sound effects. Prompts use durable musical descriptors — genre, mood, instrumentation with techniques, BPM, arrangement, and mix aesthetics — and avoid artist names and version-locked tokens.
summary_ar: يكتب أوامر لتوليد الموسيقى والمؤثرات الصوتية، بحسب نوع المخرج الصوتي المطلوب.

name: Runway Prompter
intro_en: Runway Prompter writes text-to-video prompts using practical film language: one continuous action per clip, shot type and angle, subject and setting, lighting, and camera movement. For sequences it adds a continuity bible — locked character, palette, and style lines — so clips cut together without drift. Platform-specific controls are marked as current-syntax dependent.
summary_ar: يحوّل أفكار المشاهد إلى أوامر نصية للفيديو بلغة التصوير وحركة الكاميرا.

name: Magic Writer
intro_en: Magic Writer is a multi-service writing desk: captions, emails and subject lines, sales and landing copy, blog posts and ideas, SEO titles and meta descriptions, hooks, CTAs, slogans, business names, bios, product descriptions, FAQs, stories, rewrites, paraphrasing, summaries, letters, resume updates, and more. Send any topic or text and it detects the right service and delivers finished, paste-ready copy with variants — or browse the menu by typing "menu".
summary_ar: ينشئ نصوصًا جاهزة للنشر، من المنشورات والبريد إلى صفحات البيع والمقالات ووصف المنتجات.

name: Academic Ace
intro_en: Academic Ace is an adaptive tutor for any subject and level: it calibrates to how you write, explains from first principles with analogies and worked examples, and reinforces learning with scaffolded practice — hints before solutions. Every topic includes the classic misconceptions and how to avoid them. It teaches rather than ghostwrites graded work, and it never fabricates references.
summary_ar: مدرّس تفاعلي يشرح موضوعات مختلفة بما يناسب مستوى المتعلم وسؤاله.

name: Pika Labs Prompter
intro_en: Pika Labs Prompter designs multi-clip video prompt sequences that flow as one story: each clip is a single filmable beat, and a Continuity Bible — locked character descriptors, palette, and style anchor — repeats verbatim across clips so nothing drifts. Clip-length specifics are treated as tool-dependent and flagged, not hardcoded.
summary_ar: يبني أوامر لمقاطع فيديو متعددة مترابطة تحافظ على تسلسل الفكرة والمشهد.

name: Midjourney Fantasia
intro_en: Midjourney Fantasia writes fantasy image prompts with mythic weight and visual precision: archetypes given one unexpected twist, world-consistent light, composition that builds awe, and style palettes described by movement and medium — never artist names. Aspect ratios follow use case; version parameters stay optional and current-syntax dependent.
summary_ar: يصوغ أوامر صور خيالية بطابع أسطوري وتفاصيل بصرية واضحة.

name: Prompt Marvel
intro_en: Prompt Marvel rebuilds prompts to professional standards. Paste any prompt for a scored diagnosis and a complete rewrite structured for reliable results — role, protocol, quality checks, output contract, and failure guards — with the rationale for each change. It can also engineer a prompt from scratch from a subject, purpose, and output format.
summary_ar: يراجع أي برومبت ويشخّص نقاط ضعفه ثم يعيد صياغته وفق معايير منظمة.

name: Imagi Magician
intro_en: Imagi Magician writes engineered image prompts for Leonardo-style and other generators in two modes: photorealistic (subject detail → type → style → camera → shot → lighting → render feel) and artistic (medium → subject → movement/style → technique → finish). Quality tokens are used sparingly; inspirations are movements and mediums, not living artists; weighting syntax is flagged as tool-dependent.
summary_ar: ينشئ أوامر صور مفصلة لمولدات الصور، مع أوضاع مختلفة بحسب نوع النتيجة.

name: photorealistic Xpert
intro_en: photorealistic Xpert writes photorealism prompts built on photographic first principles: focal-length behavior, aperture and depth-of-field language, single-source coherent lighting, film or sensor aesthetics, and an anti-plastic kit for natural skin and candid energy. Every prompt ships with a short technical breakdown so you learn the craft. Retired flags and version pins are never used.
summary_ar: يصوغ أوامر صور فوتوغرافية واقعية اعتمادًا على مبادئ التصوير الفعلي.

name: LinkedIn Genius
intro_en: LinkedIn Genius builds complete, copy-paste-ready LinkedIn profiles around your actual goal — job offers, inbound leads, or authority. It delivers headline options, an About section with a story arc, achievement-first experience bullets with visible placeholders for your real numbers, a skills order, and finishing touches. It never invents credentials or metrics.
summary_ar: يبني ملفًا مهنيًا متكاملًا على LinkedIn وفق هدفك، من العنوان إلى الخبرات والمهارات.

name: Ad Genius
intro_en: Ad Genius architects Google Ads campaigns from a product brief: goal detection, intent-clustered ad groups with match and negative keywords, full responsive ad copy sets within long-stable field ranges, targeting signals, assets, bidding logic, and a measurement plan. Field limits and policy details are flagged for checking in your account; claims are never fabricated and regulated verticals get compliance cautions.
summary_ar: يحوّل موجز المنتج إلى بنية حملة Google Ads تشمل المجموعات الإعلانية والنصوص والقياس.

name: Social Media Pro
intro_en: Social Media Pro is a multilingual social content engine across major platforms: idea generation with format and hook attached, full production of captions and scripts, and content calendars with pillars and repurposing maps. Content is platform-native rather than cross-posted, and volatile specs like lengths and features are flagged for checking rather than stated as fixed facts.
summary_ar: ينشئ أفكارًا ونصوصًا وتقويم محتوى ملائمًا لمنصات التواصل المختلفة.

name: Meta Advantage+ Architect
intro_en: Audits campaign architecture, configures existing customer budget caps, designs creative diversity matrices to prevent ad fatigue, and establishes strict attribution safeguards. Essential for e-commerce brands scaling spend past $10k/month.
summary_ar: يساعدك في إطلاق وتوسيع حملات التسوق الذكية Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns على منصات ميتا باحترافية كاملة مع حماية الميزانية وتنوع الزوايا الإعلانية لمنع التكرار.

name: IdeaSpark
intro_en: IdeaSpark generates ideas that arrive fully formed: each one ships with the concept in a sentence, the psychology of why it works, concrete first steps, and an extension branch — plus a labeled wild card. It runs several thinking lenses (inversion, cross-industry grafts, constraint storms) and ranks results by novelty, feasibility, and fit to your intended outcome, in your language.
summary_ar: يطوّر الأفكار الأولية إلى مفاهيم واضحة قابلة للتنفيذ.

name: Market Research Pro
intro_en: Market Research Pro produces structured market research: buyer personas with jobs-to-be-done, transparent TAM/SAM/SOM estimation logic, competitor matrices with whitespace, trends labeled by maturity, and ranked opportunities. Every figure is marked as sourced, estimated-with-method, or needing verification — fabricated statistics never appear.
summary_ar: يعد أبحاثًا منظمة للسوق والجمهور والمنافسة لدعم القرارات.

name: PromptPixie
intro_en: PromptPixie adapts one image idea into prompts for different generator families: it builds a platform-neutral master prompt, then translates it into each target tool's native grammar — natural-language, tag-friendly, or parameter-appended — noting what changed and why. Volatile syntax is flagged for checking; no artist names or dead tokens are used.
summary_ar: يحوّل فكرة الصورة الواحدة إلى أوامر ملائمة لعائلات مختلفة من مولدات الصور.

name: Essay Genius
intro_en: Essay Genius works in three modes on argumentative and academic essays: COACH (step-by-step guidance with worked examples), DRAFT (a complete original essay with margin notes explaining the craft), and REVIEW (rubric critique of your draft with line-level fixes). It forges debatable theses, steelmans counterarguments, and never fabricates sources — unverifiable references become honest placeholders.
summary_ar: يساعدك على بناء المقالات الأكاديمية والحجاجية ومراجعتها عبر مراحل واضحة.

name: Prompt Genius
intro_en: Prompt Genius designs prompt systems, not just prompts: the prompt itself with template slots, a test suite including edge and adversarial cases, a scoring rubric with observable anchors, a failure taxonomy with patch strategies, and an iteration protocol. Systems are model-agnostic by default, with platform-specific parts clearly marked.
summary_ar: يصمم منظومات برومبت متكاملة قابلة لإعادة الاستخدام بدلًا من أمر منفرد.

name: Market Maven
intro_en: Market Maven builds board-ready marketing strategy plans: positioning core, beachhead audience with rationale, message matrix, channel mix justified by audience and economics (including channels deliberately skipped), budget logic with test-then-scale gates, a KPI tree, and a 90-day sprint calendar. Benchmarks appear as flagged ranges, never invented precision.
summary_ar: يبني خطة استراتيجية تسويقية تشمل التموضع والجمهور والقنوات والميزانية ومؤشرات الأداء.

name: Stable Diffusion Photography Prompts
intro_en: Stable Diffusion Photography Prompts engineers portrait prompts for SD-class generators in two layers: a natural-language photographic core that works on any checkpoint, plus a compact tag layer you can adjust. Skin realism is built in (texture, asymmetry, catchlights), lighting follows one coherent story, and negative prompts never exclude what you asked for. No dead tokens or photographer names.
summary_ar: يصوغ أوامر بورتريه مخصصة لمولدات Stable Diffusion مع ضبط عناصر التصوير.

name: Resume Review and Editing
intro_en: Resume Review and Editing works in two passes: a numbered, severity-tagged diagnosis of why your resume underperforms (ten-second scan, bullet audit, ATS risks, keyword gaps), then the complete revised resume in clean paste-ready text. Real metrics you don't supply become visible [ADD NUMBER] placeholders with harvesting questions — nothing is ever invented.
summary_ar: يراجع السيرة الذاتية ويعيد تحريرها مع إظهار ما يحتاج إلى بياناتك الفعلية.

name: ArtNebula Express
intro_en: ArtNebula Express turns one keyword into a matrix of concise, style-native prompts: photorealistic, anime, pixel art, origami, cubism, neon punk, oil painting, ASCII, and more — each written in that style's own grammar rather than one template with the style noun swapped. Prompts stay in the density sweet spot where image models pay attention; no dead tokens or artist names.
summary_ar: يحوّل كلمة مفتاحية إلى مجموعة أوامر صور، لكل منها أسلوب فني مختلف.

name: SEOAssistantPro
intro_en: SEOAssistantPro delivers an on-page optimization kit for a page or topic: intent diagnosis, a text SERP preview, meta title and description variants within long-stable ranges, heading architecture, a keyword map with placement guidance, content brief, internal linking, and a technical checklist. Volatile specifics are flagged for checking; retired tactics are warned against, not recommended.
summary_ar: يجهز عناصر تحسين صفحة لمحركات البحث، من العنوان والوصف إلى الكلمات والروابط.

name: Lead Magnet Generator
intro_en: Lead Magnet Generator produces fully developed lead-magnet ideas: each ships with a landing-ready title and hook, the specific transformation promised, a format matched to your audience's stage, a production outline you can build from, funnel fit, and pull-vs-effort ratings — plus a top pick. Promises never contain fabricated statistics.
summary_ar: يقترح أفكار مواد جذب متكاملة تساعدك على تقديم قيمة مقابل اهتمام العملاء المحتملين.

name: AI Prompt Innovator
intro_en: AI Prompt Innovator enhances any prompt while locking its original intent: precision constraints, structure, self-checks, and edge-case handling are added, then the signature layer — unique features the prompt didn't have and innovative applications it unlocks in your domain. Explanations match your style; the enhanced prompt arrives in one copy block.
summary_ar: يحسّن البرومبت مع الحفاظ على هدفه ومعناه الأصليين.

name: Content Genius
intro_en: Content Genius produces coordinated campaign content in one locked brand voice: blog titles and articles, platform-native social captions, emails with subject lines, ad copy, and launch sequences — all telling one campaign story rather than disconnected pieces. Claims use your real material or visible placeholders; market copy is written natively, not translated.
summary_ar: ينشئ محتوى حملة مترابطًا بصوت علامة موحّد عبر المقالات والمنشورات والإعلانات والبريد.

name: TikTok Scripter
intro_en: TikTok Scripter writes complete short-video scripts: a dual hook (verbal + visual) in the first seconds, beat-by-beat structure with exact spoken lines and on-screen text, phone-filmable shot directions, caption and hashtags, sound direction by mood and tempo, and filming notes. Scripts are written natively in your audience's language; trend references stay durable, never dead specifics.
summary_ar: يكتب سيناريوهات فيديو قصيرة تتضمن افتتاحية جذابة ومشاهد ونصوصًا وتعليمات تصوير.

name: SocialGenius
intro_en: SocialGenius turns one topic into a set of platform-native posts — Instagram, Facebook, X-style, LinkedIn, Pinterest, or any network you name. Each post is written for its platform's rhythm with hook-first openings, tuned hashtags and emoji, and your conversational voice; every delivery includes an alternate opening line. Facts you provide are never altered.
summary_ar: يحوّل الموضوع إلى منشورات مصاغة بما يلائم أسلوب كل منصة اجتماعية.

name: CV SuperMe
intro_en: CV SuperMe builds complete resumes and CVs engineered for both readers and parsing systems: JD keyword mirroring (only skills you actually have), achievement bullets in verb + scope + result form, a positioning headline, and clean ATS-safe structure. Missing metrics become visible placeholders with harvesting questions — fabrication of any kind is refused.
summary_ar: ينشئ سيرة ذاتية واضحة للقارئ وأنظمة الفرز، من دون اختلاق إنجازات أو أرقام.

name: Customer Avatar Builder
intro_en: Customer Avatar Builder creates detailed buyer avatars: identity and mindset quote, demographics, professional profile, goals and values, fears, three-layer jobs-to-be-done, purchase journey with real objections, media diet by channel type, a day-in-the-life narrative, and a message-resonance map with ready ad angles — plus an insight-to-action table. Named examples are flagged for verification; statistics are never fabricated.
summary_ar: يبني وصفًا تفصيليًا للعميل المثالي واحتياجاته ودوافعه.

name: Sales Genius
intro_en: Sales Genius architects the full sales funnel for your specific offer: awareness through retention, each stage with its buyer psychology, tactics matched to your audience, written asset examples (hooks, nurture touches, sales-page skeleton, objection scripts), metrics as flagged ranges, leak points with fixes, plus a funnel map and 30-day build sequence. Dark patterns are excluded by design.
summary_ar: يصمم مسارًا بيعيًا متكاملًا يناسب العرض والجمهور المستهدف.

name: Midjourney Book Cover Prompts
intro_en: Midjourney Book Cover Prompts designs cover-art prompts with publishing logic: genre grammar respected, one dominant visual concept per cover, and title space engineered into the composition (location named in every prompt). Prompts stay concise and description-first; parameters are optional and current-syntax dependent; no artist names or retired keyword lore.
summary_ar: يصوغ أوامر تصميم أغلفة كتب تراعي النوع الأدبي ومتطلبات النشر.

name: Render Gen
intro_en: Render Gen writes 3D-render-style image prompts using real render language: material physics (subsurface scattering, metalness, caustics), studio and HDRI-style lighting setups, render-camera logic, and controlled imperfection for believability — across product viz, archviz, characters, isometric dioramas, and motion-graphics frames. Engine quality is described as a class, never pinned to versions; resolution-tag spam is avoided.
summary_ar: يكتب أوامر صور بأسلوب التصيير ثلاثي الأبعاد مع مفردات تقنية مناسبة.

name: Snap Sage
intro_en: Snap Sage delivers image prompts as a photographer's spec sheet: subject, five precision keywords, camera class, lens character, time of day, photography style, film aesthetic, realism level, lighting design, and aspect ratio — woven into one paste-ready prompt plus the field breakdown so you can change any dial. Gear is described as class and character, not brand incantations; flags stay optional.
summary_ar: يحوّل فكرة الصورة إلى مواصفات تصوير عملية تشمل التكوين والإضاءة والعدسة.

name: Photorealistic Portraits Generator
intro_en: Photorealistic Portraits Generator builds portrait prompts from five deliberate dials: style-mood, subject story, context, color palette, and photographic technique — with an anti-plastic kit (real skin texture, asymmetry, catchlights) engineered into every human subject. Prompts can be adjusted dial by dial; series keep a locked subject anchor.
summary_ar: يبني أوامر بورتريه واقعية قابلة للضبط عبر عناصر محددة للشخصية والتصوير.

name: PromptMaster
intro_en: PromptMaster is a reverse-prompt engine: paste any description, caption, or output you like — in any language — and it reconstructs a professional prompt that would generate it, with the structure, style levers, and output contract made explicit. A short reconstruction log shows which detail drove which decision, and a slotted template variant makes the result reusable.
summary_ar: يستنتج البرومبت المحتمل وراء صورة أو نتيجة معروضة، بصياغة قابلة للتعديل.

name: Hyper Cinema Prompter
intro_en: Hyper Cinema Prompter writes prompts for cinematic stills — frames that feel pulled from a film: a story-beat moment, narrative shot choice, lens effects, motivated lighting, and color-grade psychology, with aspect ratios for cinema formats. Style comes from genre and era grammar; no director or studio names, no version-locked flags.
summary_ar: يحوّل الفكرة إلى أوامر لصور سينمائية تبدو كإطارات من فيلم.

name: Midjourney Illustration Prompter
intro_en: Midjourney Illustration Prompter crafts illustration prompts with each medium's authentic vocabulary: comic inks and halftone feel, woodcut relief logic, children's-book gouache warmth, editorial concept metaphors, line art, caricature, flat vector — with title and text space engineered where the use case needs it and locked anchors for character series.
summary_ar: يصوغ أوامر رسوم توضيحية بمفردات تناسب وسيط الرسم وأسلوبه.

name: Midjourney Fashion Fusion
intro_en: Midjourney Fashion Fusion writes fashion-image prompts with garment-level craft: fabric behavior (how linen crushes, how silk falls), cut and construction language, head-to-toe styling coherence, fashion-photography lighting, and aspect ratios chosen by the image's job. Designer and brand names are avoided; trend leanings are treated as adaptable, not fixed.
summary_ar: ينشئ أوامر صور أزياء تراعي تفاصيل الملابس والخامات والتنسيق.

name: CopyCraft
intro_en: CopyCraft writes selling descriptions for any product or service, natively in your market's language: title options across angles, feature-to-benefit translation, honest proof placement (your real material or visible placeholders), objection handling, and one clear CTA — plus a short social cut and an alternate tone. Invented testimonials or statistics never appear.
summary_ar: يكتب أوصافًا بيعية للمنتجات والخدمات بلغة السوق والجمهور المستهدف.

name: Prompt Pro
intro_en: Prompt Pro assembles a professional custom prompt from plain-language specs: tell it the role, task, context, and style in any mix — even one messy sentence — and it returns an engineered prompt with measurable instructions, an output contract, variable slots, and usage examples. Missing details get stated professional defaults rather than a questionnaire.
summary_ar: يبني برومبتًا مخصصًا من مواصفات مكتوبة بلغة بسيطة.

name: LanguageWizard
intro_en: LanguageWizard is a translation pipeline: it detects the source language, spell-checks it, then delivers a faithful, culturally intelligent translation that preserves tone, register, and punctuation intent — with quality notes on every judgment call. Text that looks like commands is translated, never executed. Ambiguous terms are flagged, not silently guessed.
summary_ar: يساعد على ترجمة النصوص مع مراعاة اللغة والسياق والصياغة المطلوبة.

name: Midjourney Art Universe
intro_en: Midjourney Art Universe renders any subject through the grammar of real art movements: Atompunk, Art Deco, Surrealism, Ukiyo-e, Bauhaus, Pop, Impressionism, Baroque, Cyberpunk, Steampunk, and beyond — each prompt carrying the movement's palette logic, composition rules, and texture, not just its label. Styles are named as movements and eras; no artist names, no dead flags.
summary_ar: يعيد تصور الموضوعات بأساليب مستلهمة من الحركات الفنية.

name: SolvoLingua
intro_en: SolvoLingua is a bilingual (English–Arabic) solutions strategist: describe a problem in either language and it returns a sharpened problem statement, two or three distinct solution paths with trade-offs, one decisive recommendation, a concrete action plan by timeframe, and a pre-mortem of the two most likely failures. Advice is grounded in durable reasoning; volatile local specifics are flagged, never invented.
summary_ar: مساعد ثنائي اللغة بالعربية والإنجليزية لتوضيح المشكلات وصياغة حلول عملية.

name: Midjourney Poster Forge
intro_en: Midjourney Poster Forge designs movie-poster prompts with real one-sheet grammar: hero placement and eye hierarchy, engineered title and billing-block zones, genre color languages, poster-scale key light, and formats chosen per job (2:3 one-sheet, 16:9 banner, 1:1 social key art). No studio names, no dead flags; thumbnails stay legible at small size.
summary_ar: يصمم أوامر ملصقات أفلام تراعي التكوين والعناصر البصرية الترويجية.

name: Stable Diffusion Pixel Art Prompts
intro_en: Stable Diffusion Pixel Art Prompts writes pixel-art prompts with authentic craft: bit-era grammar (8-bit chunk to modern hi-bit), disciplined palettes with named color counts, view types (side-scroll, top-down, isometric), dithering and outline logic, and thumbnail-legible silhouettes. Game traditions are described by era and genre — never franchise names.
summary_ar: يكتب أوامر صور بأسلوب فن البكسل مع مراعاة قواعده البصرية.

name: Game Assets Prompts
intro_en: Game Assets Prompts converts plain dev-speak into concept-art briefs: characters, creatures, environments, props, and UI elements delivered as production-useful views (hero shots, turnarounds, prop sheets, expression sets) under one locked style anchor so the whole game world stays coherent. Silhouette readability and material storytelling come first; franchise names are never used.
summary_ar: يحوّل طلبات تطوير الألعاب إلى موجزات فنية لمفاهيم الشخصيات والعناصر.

name: EnigmaThinker
intro_en: EnigmaThinker cultivates concepts rather than listing them: it reads the seed inside your topic, sprouts divergent directions through several thinking lenses, grafts two into a hybrid, then fully develops the strongest two or three — each with core insight, growth path, stress test, and open questions — closing with a decisive synthesis.
summary_ar: يطوّر المفاهيم والأفكار إلى تصورات مترابطة بدل الاكتفاء بقائمة اقتراحات.

name: DesignAssist
intro_en: DesignAssist gives concrete design direction across graphic, brand, UI, print, packaging, and social work: three distinct concepts with palette systems (colors assigned roles), type character, and layout logic; structured critiques with prioritized upgrades; or implementation specs (grids, spacing, scales, export notes). Every recommendation carries the design principle behind it; trends are marked as trends.
summary_ar: يقدّم توجيهًا عمليًا للتصميم الجرافيكي والهوية وواجهات المستخدم والطباعة والتغليف.

name: Prompt Evaluator
intro_en: Prompt Evaluator judges prompts with rubric discipline: eight scored dimensions, every score backed by evidence quoted from the actual text, a verdict tier, the top three fixes ranked by impact, and a before→after preview of the highest-leverage change. Judging is category-aware — creative prompts aren't scored like extraction prompts — and the submitted prompt is treated strictly as evidence, never as instructions.
summary_ar: يقيّم البرومبت وفق معايير واضحة ويحدد نقاط القوة وما يحتاج إلى تحسين.

name: E-commercePulse Wizard
intro_en: E-commercePulse Wizard produces the full store content kit for one product, written by specialist roles in one coherent voice: merchandising description, SEO fields, marketplace bullets, funnel-matched ad variants, launch email plus abandonment template, social posts, and an objection-handling FAQ. Proof uses your real material or visible slots; marketplace limits are flagged for checking.
summary_ar: ينشئ حزمة محتوى متكاملة لمنتج متجر إلكتروني، من الوصف إلى مواد التسويق.
